ambiguities.fragment: add System-B to their downstream systems
ambiguities.explanation: The phrase 'downstream systems' is used as a noun phrase, but the verb 'add' creates ambiguity regarding the direction of the relationship. It is unclear if System-A is adding System-B as a consumer (receiving events) or as a provider (sending events), or if 'downstream systems' refers to a specific subset of external systems defined elsewhere.
possible_interpretations: System-A must configure System-B to receive events from System-A (System-B is a downstream consumer).
System-A must configure System-B to send events to System-A (System-B is a downstream provider).
textual_evidence: add System-B to their downstream systems
context_evidence: External systems that receive events from System-A.
